name: Master Orchestrator
description: n8n master dispatcher exposing 16 workspace actions behind a single webhook. Routes inbound action payloads to the right downstream system (postgres, telegram, github, drive, tasks, sheets, docs, slides, gumroad, ollama, cloudflare, notion, tavily, gmail, workspace_admin, excel). High sensitivity because the action set spans every connected workspace credential.

skills.name: Postgres
skills.description: Runs a parameterized SQL statement against the n8n postgres database and returns the result set.

skills.name: Telegram
skills.description: Posts a message to a configured telegram chat through the bot credential.

skills.name: GitHub
skills.description: Performs a GitHub API operation (read repo, open issue, comment) under the orchestrator service token.

skills.name: Drive
skills.description: Lists, reads, or writes Google Drive resources scoped to the orchestrator OAuth grant.

skills.name: Tasks
skills.description: Creates or updates Google Tasks entries on the orchestrator-linked account.

skills.name: Sheets
skills.description: Reads or appends rows in a Google Sheet keyed by spreadsheet id.

skills.name: Docs
skills.description: Reads or appends content in a Google Doc keyed by document id.

skills.name: Slides
skills.description: Reads or updates a Google Slides deck under the orchestrator OAuth grant.

skills.name: Gumroad
skills.description: Reads product, sale, and payout data from the Gumroad API.

skills.name: Ollama
skills.description: Proxies an inference call to the local Ollama runtime. Deprecated at the n8n action layer; preserved as a card skill until the workflow is purged.

skills.name: Cloudflare
skills.description: Performs a Cloudflare API call (DNS, zone, WAF rule) under the orchestrator token.

skills.name: Notion
skills.description: Reads or writes Notion pages and databases under the orchestrator integration.

skills.name: Tavily
skills.description: Performs a Tavily web search and returns scored results.

skills.name: Gmail
skills.description: Sends a message via the orchestrator-linked Gmail account.

skills.name: Workspace Admin
skills.description: Performs a Google Workspace admin API call (users, groups, security) under the admin credential.

skills.name: Excel
skills.description: Reads or appends rows in a Microsoft Excel workbook via the Graph API.
